# Jonathan Pierce — Investment Banker (Sell-Side)

- **Relationship:** external; Managing Director at a boutique investment bank. Retained as SCP's
  **sell-side advisor on the [Ironwood Industrial](../projects/ironwood-industrial.md) exit** —
  runs the auction and manages buyer outreach.
- **Cadence:** weekly exit-process call.
- **Owns:** the CIM (Confidential Information Memorandum), the buyer list, and process timeline for
  Ironwood.
- **Distinguishing fact:** long-time SCP banker; has sold two prior SCP portfolio companies.

## Notes
- All buyer conversations must be shared with Ironwood CEO
  [Michael Devlin](michael-devlin.md) first — he must not be blindsided (see Devlin's file).
- Ironwood CIM sign-off is owed to Jonathan — see [commitments](../commitments.md).
